name: Innovex 16" 4-Speed Stand Fan with Timer ISF009
description: 16-inch Innovex stand fan with 4 speed settings, oscillation, height adjustment and timer. Powerful 55W motor with 1-year warranty.
details: The Innovex ISF009 16" Stand Fan delivers strong airflow with 4 speed settings and a convenient timer function. It features a bearing motor for longer life, oscillation free neck, round base and height adjustment. Lightweight yet stable design makes it ideal for homes, offices or bedrooms in Sri Lanka. Comes with a 1-year warranty.
